description: Saskatoon Police created unit to enforce outstanding warrants.
Unit focuses on public safety and procedural justice mandates.
Unit executed 354 priority warrants, arresting 250 offenders.

chips.text: Chief McBride stated bail reform is moving in the right direction but needs more steps.
Unit ensures compliance with R. v. Jordan Supreme Court decision on trial timelines.

description: Police report details 4% budget cut impacts.
Cuts would affect proactive programs, cybersecurity.

chips.text: Commissioner Jeffries requested more specific details on potential service cuts.
Council sought more specific details on potential cuts than report provided.
Not strengthening cybersecurity leaves police open to cyber attack.
Increased homelessness and individuals in crisis drive police service demand.
Police administration promised to provide verbal examples of cuts to Council.
